privacyNotice.title: Before your first upload
privacyNotice.body: Study Buddy sends your files to an external AI service (through OpenRouter) to make your quizzes, flashcards, summaries, and answers. Your files are used only for your own study material, aren't shared with other users, and aren't kept by the AI service.
